usage: 牛肉球 is a noun referring to a type of dim sum made of steamed beef meatballs.
It is often used to order food in a restaurant or describe food preferences.
You can use 牛肉球 as the subject or object in a sentence, e.g., 'I like 牛肉球' or 'We ordered 牛肉球.'
In Cantonese conversations, 牛肉球 frequently appears when discussing dim sum menus or favorite dishes.
牛肉球 can also appear in combination with other dim sum items when listing choices.
